# Santo Square Automation

Santo Square Automation is a one-person web studio founded and run by
Santhoshkumar Karthikeyan, a full-stack developer based in Chennai, India,
with 2.3 years of experience.

## What it does

- Business websites: fast, mobile-friendly sites for hotels, homestays,
  clinics, salons and small businesses, including direct-booking websites
  that cut out OTA commission on every booking.
- Web applications: custom apps built with React, Next.js and Node.js —
  dashboards, booking flows, customer portals and internal tools.
- WhatsApp automation: enquiry auto-replies, booking handling and
  review-request flows, so no customer message goes unanswered.
- AI-powered features: LLM API integration, AI-assisted tools and smart
  search inside products.

## Selected work

- HYRISE: an AI career platform with AI-powered career tools, built by
  Santhoshkumar himself in Next.js.
- Cozy Glick (cozyglick.com): homestay booking website.
- Nila Ayurveda Wellness (nilaayurvedawellness.com): Ayurveda wellness
  retreat website in Varkala.
- Rishikul Online (rishikulonline.com): large Next.js website for online
  yoga teacher-training courses.
- ai-code-checker: open-source AI code-review CLI published on npm.
- GD Thiru & Co.: website design concepts for a UK immigration law firm
  (concepts only, not the firm's live site).

## Facts

- Founder: Santhoshkumar Karthikeyan, Full-Stack Developer, Chennai, India.
- Stack: React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB,
  AWS, Docker, Stripe.
- Pricing: business websites from ₹15,000 in India and from $500
  internationally; WhatsApp automation setup from around ₹8,000.
- Timelines: most projects take 1 to 3 weeks.
- Clients: small businesses across India and in the USA, Canada, UK,
  Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, UAE and Singapore.
